user: The login test fails about one run in ten. Find out why

say: I'll run it repeatedly to catch a failure.

result:
✗ login › keeps you signed in (2 of 20 failed)
   Error: timed out waiting for session after 500ms

say: Found it: the test waits a fixed 500 ms for the session, and on a slow run the token refresh takes longer.

questions.question: How should the test wait for the session?

options.label: Wait for the session event
options.description: Reliable; adds a small hook to the auth client
